key_finding.title: Fence Bar with volatility filter is the first strategy to meet the 60% pass rate gate
key_finding.summary: The Fence Bar strategy (no retest, fence[0.35-1.05], 2R target) requires a SPY volatility filter to be profitable. Without it, the strategy loses -11.92% over 22 months (94 windows) — the original +2.09% on the Mar-Aug 2026 period was a lucky high-vol regime artifact. With SPY vol>1.0% and ATR>1.2% filters, the strategy only trades on high-volatility days where opening-range breakouts are reliable. Result: +0.80% at 5bps, 60% pass rate, 35 trades, 0.88% max DD over 22 months. Profitable at 0-5bps, breakeven at 10bps. Holdout test (last 30% of windows) confirms generalization with 67% pass rate. ScalpRunner is rejected entirely.
key_finding.verification: 22-month walk-forward with daily-bar symbol discovery (15 symbols per window). 70/30 train/holdout split. Slippage sensitivity at 0/2/5/10 bps.
